# The photo dialog clears preview attributes without clearing the file input

The change handler forwards the single selected file to showWithFile. The close handler returns to the target state, which clears the preview image href, width and height and hides the banner. Neither inspected path clears the native input value. Same-file reselection and native change-event behavior remain unverified.

Scope: Address-book photo input reset.
